## ECPR Newsletter – {{< meta issue >}}/{{< meta year >}}

::: section
May is here, and so is a fresh issue of the ECPR PolCom Newsletter. This month, we have three announcements from the Standing Group: a **mentoring event** at the ECPR General Conference in Krakow; an open call for volunteers to join the **Best Paper Award jury**; and a reminder that our member **survey** is still open and your input shapes what we do next. We also highlight several **external events** worth putting on your radar.


<!-- Table of Contents; Delete if not wished: -->
::: {.issue-toc}
:::

:::

## Junior–Senior Mentoring in Krakow

::: section
![](https://thieled.github.io/ecpr-newsletter/issues/2025/12/img/Krakow_sq.png){.newsimg width="180"}

Are you attending the ECPR General Conference 2026 in Krakow? We are organizing a **Junior–Senior Mentoring** initiative in political communication. 

The idea is simple: we match junior and senior scholars based on shared research interests, and you meet once informally during the conference to exchange ideas, experiences, and advice. Interested in joining?

Please sign up--as *senior* or *junior* scholar--by submitting your details below and we'll get in touch with you. Please note that we have limited availibilities for the junior scholars.

Deadline to register is **May 23**.

<button class="readmore">
<a href="https://uantwerpen.eu.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_do6RSAAiYnAEiSq">Sign up!</a>
</button>
:::


## Volunteer for the Best Paper Award '25 Jury!

::: section
![](https://thieled.github.io/ecpr-newsletter/assets/icons/roundel.png){.newsimg width="180"}

We're still short of jury members for our **Best Paper Award (BPA)** comittee! 

If you want to **volunteer** to become part of the BPA committee to select the best paper presented in the PolComm section at the ECPR General Conference 2025 in Thessaloniki, please sign up and we'll get in touch with you.

Deadline to register is **May 20**.

<button class="readmore">
<a href="https://uantwerpen.eu.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_eFJLSc91AkfaP0G">Sign up for the BPA!</a>
</button>
:::

### GESIS Fall Seminar in Computational Social Science (31 Aug–29 Sep)

::: section

The *GESIS Fall Seminar in Computational Social Science* runs **31 August–29 September** in Mannheim or online, offering introductory and advanced courses on digital behavioral data. This year's programme covers Web Data Collection, Machine Learning for Text Analysis, LLMs, Computer Vision, and more — highly relevant for political communication scholars working or planning to work with digital trace data and computational methods.

<button class="readmore"><a href="https://gesis.org/fallseminar">Read more</a></button>

:::

## ECREA Pre-conference: Instant Messaging as Political Communication Infrastructure

::: section

The pre-conference *Instant Messaging as Political Communication Infrastructure* brings together scholars advancing theory and methods for studying platforms like WhatsApp, Telegram, and Signal as sites of political communication. Taking place on **7 September 2026** at the Faculty of Social Studies, Masaryk University, Brno, the event is organized around two tracks: **Pro-Democratic Political Communication** and **Anti-Democratic Political Communication**.

Submissions (1,000–1,500 words) are invited for original research, theoretical and methodological contributions, toolkits, and data repositories. Submission deadline: **15 May 2026**. Registration fees: ECREA members €40 | Non-members €60 | PhD students €25. 

For queries contact [**o.pasitselska@rug.nl**](mailto:o.pasitselska@rug.nl).

Submission deadline: **15 May 2026**

<button class="readmore"><a href="https://bit.ly/IMPolComm">Read more</a></button>

:::


## VIRUS Kick‑off Seminar: Narrative Justification of Russian Violence

::: section

The *VIRUS* kick‑off seminar presents research on *Violence by Russia in Ukraine* — specifically how narratives justifying violence shape public opinion and political communication across Russia and European contexts. Presented by **Polina Zavershinskaia**, chaired by **Matteo Bassoli**, with discussant **Pietro De Perini**.

The event takes place on **10 June 2026, 12:30–14:00** at the Department of Political Science, Law and International Studies, Padua, and is available online via Zoom. Contact [**polina.zavershinskaia@unipd.it**](mailto:polina.zavershinskaia@unipd.it) to register.

When: **10 June 2026, 12:30–14:00**

<button class="readmore"><a href="mailto:polina.zavershinskaia@unipd.it">Sign up</a></button>

:::
